Exhibit EX-12

Screenshot of a public post

The artifact

What it shows on its face

A thread of posts from the account @JustCallMeJoeP (display name "Joe Prich", verified badge), timestamped between 2:33 AM and 3:19 AM on May 26 2026, several replying to @SkyPhusion and @jeff_peebles. In one post the account writes: "Just a broke dick, multiple felon, half-a-joo whose wife fell for a thick dicked JACKED Nazzy, who decided it'd be a good idea to run his fucking mouth to Joseph E. Prichardington the 3rd". In another: "Two days ago you were bellyaching about some f*g playing with her hair. Now you're unbothered by finding out she's smitten with a literal Nazzy?". The account thereby applies the word "Nazzy" to itself and gives its own name as "Joseph E. Prichardington the 3rd". Both are self-descriptions published by the account. Neither identifies the operator by legal name, and neither refers to any business.
